# codec

> An open-source, local-first macOS system that turns a Mac into a voice-controlled AI workstation with screen vision, app control, dictation, chat, and agent crews.

Python-based, MIT licensed, runs entirely on the Mac with no cloud dependency unless a task needs network. Main parts: CODEC Core (voice assistant with 91 skills and vision mouse control), CODEC Dictate (hold-to-dictate and live typing), CODEC Instant (right-click AI services), and CODEC Chat (250K context, 12 agent crews, four modes including autonomous Project mode). It acts as both an MCP client and MCP server, connecting to Claude, Cursor, and VS Code.

- [Audit log keeps its signing secret and counts the lines it drops (P-081)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/AUDIT-SECRET-KEEP-DESIGN.md): Fixing audit HMAC secret replacement when Keychain errors, and counting audit lines dropped on write failure.
- [Backups that check themselves, a restore tool, and stated retention](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/BACKUP-RETENTION-DESIGN.md): Self-verifying SQLite backups via codec_backup.py, one restore tool, retention settings, and recorded deletions for chats, clipboard, and webcam photos.
- [Boot grace: no false "down" or model restart in the first 5 minutes (P-059)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/BOOT-GRACE-DESIGN.md): Five-minute boot grace period preventing false service_down alerts and model server restarts during startup loading.
- [P-026 — Chat and voice know the buyer: one identity prompt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/BUYER-IDENTITY-DESIGN.md): One runtime identity prompt for chat and voice: hardware probe, skill count, About me, and facts in codec_runtime_context.py.
- [Buyer lock: every runtime import declared, no GPL pieces (D-35, audit P-011)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/BUYER-LOCK-DESIGN.md): Why bundled Python installs came from an undeclared requirements list, and how the lock and import checks fix it.
- [Create image in chat (Qwen-Image 2.1, local) — design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CHAT-CREATE-IMAGE-DESIGN.md): Design of the chat Image mode generating pictures locally with Qwen-Image 2.1, reference images and memory constraints.
- [Chat stream:false handles (SKILL:) tags like the stream (2026-11-11)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CHAT-JSON-TAG-PARITY-DESIGN.md): How stream:false chat replies resolve every [SKILL:] tag with budget and allowlist rules like the stream.
- [Deep Chat prompt budget (P-034)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CHAT-PROMPT-BUDGET-DESIGN.md): How /api/chat trims each turn's prompt to a token budget, with prefill speed measurements and attachment handling decisions.

- [Deep Chat notes on the earlier part of a long chat (P-038)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CHAT-SUMMARY-DESIGN.md): Background notes on the dropped turns of long chats, sent after the system prompt to keep early facts.

- [CODEC architecture reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/codec-architecture.md): Repo map, module responsibilities, schemas and event tables for engine helpers, persistence, lifecycle, vision and LLM code.
- [CODEC status — gaps and in-progress work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/codec-status.md): Known gaps and in-progress Phase 3.5 work: project mode UI, proactive overlay, read-path enforcement, agent job persistence.
- [CODEC voice 02 (Qwen3-TTS) — design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CODEC-VOICE-02-DESIGN.md): Design of the custom Qwen3-TTS voice 02, sample selection, existing Kokoro TTS server, and call sites across the codebase.
- [CODEC voice 02, phase 2: the live conversation voice — design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CODEC-VOICE-02-LIVE-DESIGN.md): Design and implementation of streaming live conversation replies in voice 02, sentence-based synthesis, playback, and Kokoro fallback.
- [One safe writer for config.json (P-054)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CONFIG-WRITER-DESIGN.md): How update_config replaces six unsafe config.json writes with a locked, atomic read-modify-write helper.
- [CODEC — Context Report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CONTEXT_REPORT.md): Read-only audit covering agents, crew architecture, memory, skills, scheduler, hooks, AGENTS.md placement, and brand naming.
- [Crew shell in a macOS sandbox, custom-agent tools checked — design (P-030 parts 2-4)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/CREW-SHELL-SANDBOX-DESIGN.md): Design for running crew shell_execute inside macOS sandbox-exec with owner consent, fixing the unsafe shell boundary.
- [Dashboard web hardening, stage 0 (P-089)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/DASHBOARD-CSP-STAGE0-DESIGN.md): CSP hardening plan covering img-src, connect-src, ws and data sources across dashboard pages, with the Vibe exception.
- [DAYBREAK — Morning Kickoff + Working-Threads Live Memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/DAYBREAK-DESIGN.md): How DAYBREAK assembles a morning briefing from working-threads facts stored in the memory database.
- [Controls that do nothing, and claims that are not true (P-035)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/DEAD-CONTROLS-DESIGN.md): Fixing fake sample reports in notifications.json, lock handling for mark-read, and other dead controls.
- [Doctor: one read-only check of this Mac, with a redacted support report (P-022)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/DOCTOR-DESIGN.md): Design of a read-only Mac check that finds security leftovers and builds a redacted support report.
- [P-084: one scrubbed environment for child processes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/ENV-SCRUB-DESIGN.md): Plan for codec_envscrub.py, which strips secret-named variables from child process environments.
- [P-016: blocking calls leave the dashboard's event loop (DESIGN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/EVENT-LOOP-OFFLOAD-DESIGN.md): Moving blocking dashboard handlers into asyncio.to_thread, with the _enrich_messages memory split.
- [F-15 — pyproject.toml (project metadata)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/F15-PYPROJECT-DESIGN.md): Adding pyproject.toml as declarative metadata and dependency manifest, without faking pip-installability.
- [F-4 — Ruff lint baseline + CI gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/F4-RUFF-CLEANUP-DESIGN.md): Ruff lint baseline, ruff.toml rule choices, 229 safe auto-fixes, and the CI gate.

## Audits

- [PHASE 1 AUDIT E — DISTRIBUTION + APPLE APP READINESS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-APPLE-APP.md): Audit of 18 findings on signing, notarization, and packaging CODEC as a paid Mac app.
- [PHASE 1 AUDIT A — CODE QUALITY + ARCHITECTURE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-CODE-QUALITY.md): Audit A findings: 22 issues covering entry-point duplication near codec.py, codec_core.py, codec_session.py, and silent error swallowing.
- [PHASE 1 — CONSOLIDATED TRIAGE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-CONSOLIDATED-TRIAGE.md): Consolidated results of all six Phase 1 audits plus the Pilot audit, with headline SkillRegistry.load RCE findings.
- [PHASE 1 AUDIT F — INVESTOR / ENTERPRISE-GRADE READINESS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-INVESTOR-READINESS.md): Audit F scoring investor and enterprise-readiness gaps: SECURITY.md, privacy page, CI badges, demo loop positioning.
- [Phase-1 Security Audit — CODEC Pilot (browser-automation subsystem)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-PILOT-AUDIT.md): Pilot audit findings including a live internet-exposed unauthenticated RCE via pilot-runner on :8094 and its mitigation.
- [PHASE 1 AUDIT B — PROJECTS (+ PILOT) SUBSYSTEM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-PROJECTS-PILOT.md): Audit B findings on the Projects agent runtime: structurally bypassable permission model and per-route authorization gaps.
- [PHASE 1 AUDIT C — RELIABILITY + CRASH SURFACE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-RELIABILITY.md): Audit C findings on crash surface: inter-process file races on ~/.codec JSON state, broken signal handling, in-memory job state.
- [PHASE 1 AUDIT D — SECURITY + SECRETS HANDLING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AVADSA25/codec/main/docs/audits/PHASE-1-SECURITY.md): 22 security findings: skill registry RCE, command blocklist bypasses, plaintext secrets, and the no-auth dashboard bind.
